findings.evidence: `@[simps!]` on `ClassGroup.mulEquiv` (mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/ClassGroup/Basic.lean:459) only generates the `equiv`/`QuotientGroup.congr` unfolding; `grep -n 'mulEquiv_mk' mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/ClassGroup/Basic.lean` returns nothing, so the `mk`-level computation exists nowhere. The file's own docstring (line 19) says the roadmap needs to "compute it on ideal classes" — that is precisely this lemma, and it is not exported.
findings.fix: Extract a `@[simp] theorem ClassGroup.mulEquiv_mk (f : R ≃+* S) (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R))ˣ)` stating that equation, prove it once, and reduce both proofs to `induction` + `mulEquiv_mk` + the corresponding `ringEquivOfRingEquiv_{refl,trans_apply}`.
findings.issue: `mulEquiv_refl` (lines 44-50) and `mulEquiv_trans` (lines 59-65) each re-derive the same missing fact inline: `ClassGroup.mulEquiv f (ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) I) = ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing S) (Units.mapEquiv (FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv _ _ f) I)`. Each does it differently (`rw [mulEquiv_apply]` + `(ClassGroup.equiv _).injective` + `apply_symm_apply` vs. `simp only [mulEquiv_apply, equiv_mk, QuotientGroup.congr_mk']`), so the reason the proofs work is obscured and neither route is reusable.

findings.evidence: Line 48 `congr 1` vs. line 61 `apply congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' (toPrincipalIdeal T (FractionRing T)).range)` — the same step, done robustly in one proof and heuristically in the other.
findings.fix: Use the explicit form the author already uses at line 61: `apply congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' (toPrincipalIdeal R (FractionRing R)).range)`.
findings.issue: `congr 1` is used to reduce `QuotientGroup.mk' _ a = QuotientGroup.mk' _ b` to `a = b`; `congr` splits goals heuristically and can produce `HEq` side goals when the surrounding instances or the `mk'` signature shift.

summary: Both substantive proofs (`mulEquiv_refl`, `mulEquiv_trans`) open by re-deriving the same unexposed computation of `ClassGroup.mulEquiv` on a class `ClassGroup.mk K I`, by two different ad-hoc routes; that shared fact should be a named lemma. A minor inconsistency: the same quotient-congruence step uses fragile `congr 1` in one proof and explicit `congrArg` in the other.
